$comment: Machine-readable current-state attestation for Russell Vault, owned by this repository.
It is a BOUNDED PROJECTION of verified truth, not a live mirror of production.
Every claim below carries an explicit evidenceClass. Read evidenceClasses first.
Validated by scripts/ci/current-state-guard.mjs (unit tests in current-state-guard.test.mjs).
It is deliberately NOT pinned to exact HEAD: only a change to the governed migration
set forces an update, so documentation-only commits never invalidate it.

evidenceClasses.deployed_config: Read directly from the deployed Railway service configuration or the deployed application bundle. The only class that may establish production identity.
evidenceClasses.live_schema: Read directly from a live Supabase database over an authenticated connection. Proves what a database contains, never which database production uses.
evidenceClasses.repository: Read from files at the reviewed commit in this repository.
evidenceClasses.github_api: Read from the GitHub API for an exact SHA, run id, and run attempt.
evidenceClasses.unmerged: Present only on an open pull request. Never an executable baseline.
evidenceClasses.not_inspectable: Could not be inspected from the verifying environment. Recorded as a blocker, never silently downgraded into a claim about reality.

$comment: expectedCount and lastMigrationName describe the REPOSITORY migration set at the
reviewed SHA. setDigest is sha256 over the sorted migration basenames without the
'.sql' suffix, one per line, each line newline-terminated. The digest catches a
replaced or renamed migration that leaves the count unchanged.
canonicalProjectRef stays null unless deployment verification was ACTUALLY performed.
A ledger that matches the repository is strong circumstantial evidence about a database;
it is not evidence about which database the deployed service is configured to use.
Repeating a remembered ref in more documents does not make it verified.
deploymentIdentity.authoritativeSource: VITE_SUPABASE_URL in the deployed Railway service environment, or the Supabase URL embedded in the bundle served by the live app
deploymentIdentity.blocker: Railway configuration and the live app host were not reachable from the verifying environment: the egress policy answered 403 to CONNECT for russellvault2-production.up.railway.app:443. Railway environment variables are not stored in this repository.
deploymentIdentity.destructiveActionRule: No live action may rely on this file for production identity. Before any live Supabase read, migration, reset, restore, or parity claim, re-read the deployed Supabase URL from the running environment immediately before acting, and confirm the target project ref matches it. A remembered ref, a project display name, a scoped project listing, an agent handoff, and this attestation are all insufficient.
$stateMachine: verificationPerformed is the SINGLE state variable. There is deliberately no second state label:
a duplicate could be left saying one thing while every other field says the other. The guard
rejects a 'currentState' key outright for that reason.
UNVERIFIED (verificationPerformed=false) requires: canonicalProjectRef=null; zero registry entries
with role deployed_production; evidenceClass=not_inspectable; a nonempty blocker; verifiedAtUtc=null;
verificationMethod=null; and no canonical document asserting any production project.
VERIFIED (verificationPerformed=true) requires: canonicalProjectRef is one valid ref; exactly one
registry entry has role deployed_production and equals it; that entry's evidenceClass=deployed_config;
this section's evidenceClass=deployed_config; blocker null or absent; verifiedAtUtc a strict ISO-8601
UTC instant; verificationMethod and authoritativeSource nonempty; and every production assertion in
canonical documents names that exact ref.
The transition is all-or-nothing: a partial edit fails CI rather than half-asserting an identity.

$comment: Every Supabase project ref that appears in a canonical document must be registered here.
role 'deployed_production' may only be assigned when deploymentIdentity.verificationPerformed
is true. The guard enforces both rules.

items.title: Docs: reconcile canonical production identity and current program state
items.assessment: Superseded by this repair, which preserves its valid corrections. Its production-identity and program-phase corrections were sound. Its 'Current CI state: RED' section is stale: it was written against attempt 1 of run 32265646383, and attempt 2 of that same run succeeded on the same SHA. It also asserted a canonical deployed project ref that its own evidence did not establish from deployed configuration.

programPhase.$comment: Re-proved from executable code at the reviewed SHA, not carried over from prose.

programPhase.note: Legacy SQLite surfaces (/inventory, /purchases, /cost-links, /listings, /sales, /checks) remain mounted ungated during transition and must never be conflated with governed truth.

liveParity.$comment: Parity is a claim about a NAMED database. It cannot be stated for production while production identity is unverified.
